interface.longDescription: Read-only engineering verification workflows for tool-using AI agents: 11 scoped skills, two playbooks, and an inspector role. Distinguish test execution, observed reality, and requirement status. Runtime access depends on the host and user authorization; missing evidence remains unverified. Free, open source, no bundled server or telemetry.
defaultPrompt: Audit my agent project using current evidence and report the minimum blockers.
Check whether these passing tests prove the real production path.
